t: Isanotski Strait, Alaska
s: Isanotski Strait was called Isanax̂ by the Unangan (Aleut) people. Isanax means gap, hole, rent, or tear (pass, strait) in the Aleut language and is variously spelled Issannakh, Isanak etc. in English. The name was rendered as Isanotski (or Issanakskie, Isanotskoi, etc) in transliterated Russian. 2
